summary: Frontend regression + Careers rebuild test on preview URL. Ran 3 Playwright suites: Careers page (21/21 pass), Home page sections & CapabilitiesAccordion (14/15 - one minor content note), and Regression (Solutions/Research/About-Us/Contact + mobile /careers, 14/14 pass). Footer form e2e POST /api/contacts/submit returned 200 with type=footer_form on /careers.

content_notes.issue: capability-active-heading testid renders the LONG description sentence rather than the short capability title (e.g. 'Smart Agents'). Default active toggle IS index 0 (Smart Agents), but the element the review expected to read 'Smart Agents' actually contains 'Automate tasks with AI agents connected to your apps and workflows.' Also observed toggles 2, 3, 4 all showed similar starting text 'Build and deploy purpose-built AI models...' as the active heading — description bodies differ (lens 229/302/231) so switch works, but the heading text may be miswired. Verify whether the review spec expected the short title in capability-active-heading vs. current implementation's use of the tagline as heading.

action_items: OPTIONAL/LOW: Verify Home CapabilitiesAccordion — data-testid='capability-active-heading' currently renders the long tagline; if the intent was to show the short title ('Smart Agents', 'Deep Research', etc.), swap the bindings. Toggles work correctly, so behavior is fine; only the semantic heading text may need review.
critical_code_review_comments: Multiple *_backup.jsx / Careers_Backup.jsx / Home_backup.jsx / Home1.jsx files clutter /app/frontend/src/pages/. Recommend deleting or moving to an /archive folder to keep the src tree focused on live routes.

Note: review_request stated all job rows link to '/careers/job/cdn-migration-2' — actual behavior uses role-slug URLs like '/careers/job/administration-executive-male' which is correct; the review text was misleading.
